result.rationale: Sponsor and regulatory sources identify Meyersdale as a battery/SPV beneath GlidePath, Quinbrook's manager-level PortCo. No Meyersdale-specific sponsor mandate, co-owner or later equity transfer was found.

identityResolution.boundary: Project/SPV beneath GlidePath Power Solutions; not a standalone Quinbrook PortCo.
notSameAs: Green Mountain Storage, LLC (10.4 MW battery)

ownershipResolution.chain: Meyersdale Storage, LLC → GlidePath Storage Operations LLC → GlidePath Power Operations LLC → GlidePath Power Solutions LLC/GlidePath Power LLC → three Quinbrook fund entities under common GP Quinbrook Infrastructure Partners (GP1) Ltd.
ownershipResolution.boundaryFinding: FERC groups US Wind Co-Investment Partners LP with two Quinbrook funds under one common GP; no Meyersdale-specific co-investment or project co-owner was found.
ownershipResolution.nonEquityParties: PJM/Penelec are market/interconnection parties; no lender, tax-equity investor, tolling party or contractor was evidenced as equity.

operatingResolution.currentCheck: Current Quinbrook/GlidePath pages still list it as operating.
